title: Was that a Ghost

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Is everything alright?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is everything alright?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm not sure what you're referring to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure what you're referring to.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm afraid you must be hallucinating. Did you eat any of that illegal cheese people are talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid you must be hallucinating. Did you eat any of that illegal cheese people are talking about?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I heard your attempts to interrogate thin air...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I heard your attempts to interrogate thin air...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Entirely possible. What did this apparition say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Entirely possible. What did this apparition say?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Interesting…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting…

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I just ran a search and I am coming across some Nets chatter about incorporeal emanations in this area...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just ran a search and I am coming across some Nets chatter about incorporeal emanations in this area...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You could put it that way. I have found a post on an account called "The Nivalis Nocturne".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could put it that way. I have found a post on an account called "The Nivalis Nocturne".

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: No. But the post writer wants to hear from anyone else who may have seen the ghost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. But the post writer wants to hear from anyone else who may have seen the ghost.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You already know her. The post was written by Ms Al-Zahiri, the historian.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You already know her. The post was written by Ms Al-Zahiri, the historian.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The post was written by a historian named Ms Al-Zahiri.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The post was written by a historian named Ms Al-Zahiri.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Did the apparition seem malevolent at all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did the apparition seem malevolent at all?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Then I suggest you avoid this place in future. I am picking up some unusual trace electro magnetic fluctuations…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I suggest you avoid this place in future. I am picking up some unusual trace electro magnetic fluctuations…

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Perhaps Ms Al-Zahiri knows more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps Ms Al-Zahiri knows more.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Are you sure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: A post that references an encounter with an emanation on this very spot. A specter called "the Lost Lady".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A post that references an encounter with an emanation on this very spot. A specter called "the Lost Lady".

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yes, it's called "Green Reeker". Its smell is so strong, it causes auditory and visual hallucinations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, it's called "Green Reeker". Its smell is so strong, it causes auditory and visual hallucinations.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It references seeing one such emanation on this very spot. A specter called "The Lost Lady".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It references seeing one such emanation on this very spot. A specter called "The Lost Lady".

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Like nothing happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like nothing happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What was THAT?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What was THAT?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The person who was just here... she vanished.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The person who was just here... she vanished.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The person who was just here... she vanished.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The person who was just here... she vanished.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I was JUST talking to her. You didn't hear it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I was JUST talking to her. You didn't hear it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I was JUST talking to her. You didn't hear it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I was JUST talking to her. You didn't hear it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then I’m going mad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I’m going mad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then your processors need recalibrating.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then your processors need recalibrating.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don’t know. It sounded garbled. Like code.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t know. It sounded garbled. Like code.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don’t know. It sounded garbled. Like code.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don’t know. It sounded garbled. Like code.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's get out of here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ghost sightings?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ghost sightings?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there anything else about her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there anything else about her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there anything else about her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there anything else about her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I find this person?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I find this person?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Where can I find this person?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Where can I find this person?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We need an exorcist, not a historian.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We need an exorcist, not a historian.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We need an exorcist, not a historian.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We need an exorcist, not a historian.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We had better go and talk to her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We had better go and talk to her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We had better go and talk to her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We had better go and talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, she looked sad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, she looked sad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I just don't like ghosts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I just don't like ghosts.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I just don't like ghosts.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I just don't like ghosts.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's get out of here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No... what did you find?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No... what did you find?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, I don't like ghosts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I don't like ghosts.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Illegal cheese?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Illegal cheese?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I haven't eaten any cheese. You really didn't hear anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I haven't eaten any cheese. You really didn't hear anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I haven't eaten any cheese. You really didn't hear anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I haven't eaten any cheese. You really didn't hear anything?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you mean Green Reeker, then no, I haven't eaten any.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you mean Green Reeker, then no, I haven't eaten any.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you mean Green Reeker, then no, I haven't eaten any.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you mean Green Reeker, then no, I haven't eaten any.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's what I ask you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what I ask you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That... apparition!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That... apparition!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you believe me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you believe me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How about a careful retreat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about a careful retreat?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're reading my mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're reading my mind.
